verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's docs describe Runbooks as its automation engine: they evaluate conditions whenever an incident is declared and automatically run actions such as creating Slack channels, starting Zoom meetings, or sending webhooks to internal systems. Signals Alert Rules use CEL queries, which can be backtested, to match incoming events and turn them into routed alerts, and webhooks can fire on internal events. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of how deep and reliable the rule and condition engine is.
